response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, m.facetfaces FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref), site_avg AS (SELECT zoneregistry, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS site_avg FROM matched GROUP BY zoneregistry, entrystat HAVING AVG(facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS overall_avg FROM matched), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg) AS status_avg FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), above AS (SELECT sa.site_avg, sa.site_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_overall, sa.site_avg - st.status_avg AS diff_status FROM site_avg sa JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND sa.site_avg > st.status_avg) SELECT AVG(site_avg) AS avg_face_count, AVG(diff_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(diff_status) AS avg_above_status FROM above
